notes: FINRA Margin Statistics page (read 2026-11-16) now shows Oct-26: debit balances in customers' securities margin accounts 1,448,360 USD mn (down 31,694 / -2.1% from Sep-26 record 1,480,054); free credit balances in cash accounts 210,290 (from 215,328); free credit balances in margin accounts 212,890 (from 218,581). All three fell month-on-month: first decline in margin debt after the Jul-26 1,417,225 -> Aug-26 1,453,832 -> Sep-26 1,480,054 climb. Free credit total 423,180 vs 433,909 in Sep-26. Page carries no explicit release date; FINRA says updates publish in the third week of the month following the reference month, consistent with a mid-November release.
